properties.comment: LCRA is taking a clearance in the Willow Springs substation to conduct maintenance on equipment. Members in the Shelby, Willow Springs, New Ulm, Fayetteville, Ellinger, and Roznov areas will be without power from 4:00am to 6:00am. We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your cooperation in this matter. For questions, please call our office at 979-968-3181.
